title: Luby–Rackoff Backwards Security in ICM-KOA
summary: Beyond-birthday-bound security is known for the construction in ICM, but whether it achieves such security in ICM-KOA remains open.

formal_statement.body: Revisit the Bellare--Krovetz--Rogaway Luby--Rackoff Backwards PRF-from-PRP construction in ICM-KOA and determine whether it achieves beyond-birthday-bound security in that model. Existing positive beyond-birthday-bound results for the construction are established in ICM despite the presence of secret keys, leaving its security in ICM-KOA unresolved.

scope.domain: Security of the Bellare–Krovetz–Rogaway Luby–Rackoff Backwards PRF-from-PRP construction in ideal-cipher models.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether the construction achieves beyond-birthday-bound security in ICM-KOA.

citations.label: Salvaging Weak Security Bounds for Blockcipher-Based Constructions

progress.summary: The source notes positive beyond-birthday-bound results for the construction in ICM despite secret keys, then proposes revisiting it in ICM-KOA. It does not resolve that construction-specific analysis.
citation_labels: Thomas Shrimpton et al., Salvaging Weak Security Bounds for Blockcipher-Based Constructions
